discarded_attempts.reason: Windows thread startup allowed early requests to finish before all workers were ready. Excluded from final comparison; all HTTP results rerun with a prestarted common release gate and measured in-flight peak.
Dynamic RoPE CUDA graph capture incompatibility on this Windows stack; native adapter used.
ParallelLMHead not matched by Linear; explicit lm_head target fixed loading.

discarded_attempts.case: llama API parallel=256 via standard launcher
discarded_attempts.reason: Launcher maximum is 128; invalid run excluded and dedicated server launched with 256 slots.

limitations: Community Windows vLLM wheel; not upstream official Windows support.
BF16 was quantization source only; all inference candidates use 4-bit backbone weights. Embedding/tied lm_head remain BF16 unless explicitly head variant.
Different quantization and sampling implementations: not bitwise-identical inference or a pure kernel speedup.
HTTP cold is first complete request pass after server ready, excludes server initialization and JIT before readiness.
Batch llama includes first graph preparation; vLLM reports first pass separately from warm medians. Do not conflate.
Device-wide sampled memory delta includes startup and desktop noise. Fixed vLLM KV budget differs from full per-slot llama reservation.
512 short repeated requests are not a sustained production trace or full-context stress test.
HTTP results include the standard-library threaded client, transport and SSE decoding overhead, and are not an isolated GPU capacity measurement.
GPU clocks were not locked. Desktop activity remains a source of run-to-run variation.
Quality bootstrap is exploratory, stratified by language, no multiple-comparison correction.
